title.en: The One With the Post Office Box

description.es: Marta continúa buscando pistas en todos los periódicos que puede conseguir, mientras Cloe la anima a no perder la esperanza. Darío la llama y le comparte un apartado de correos usado por Fina para un encargo. Marta descubre que Fina no está registrada ni en la embajada ni en el consulado, y le niegan información sobre el apartado. Frustrada, se desahoga con Andrés, quien le sugiere escribirle una carta. Marta admite su miedo: que Fina no quiera contestar o que ya no la ame, aunque reconoce que necesita intentarlo.
description.en: Marta keeps searching for clues in every newspaper she can get her hands on, while Cloe encourages her not to lose hope. Darío calls her and shares a post office box that Fina used for a commission. Marta discovers that Fina is registered neither at the embassy nor at the consulate, and they refuse to give her information about the box. Frustrated, she vents to Andrés, who suggests she write her a letter. Marta admits her fear: that Fina may not want to reply, or that she may no longer love her, though she acknowledges she needs to try.
